title: Some More of Our Treasure Items (continued)

items.name: Jade and gold amulet necklace
items.description: Interpretive recreation of what it might have looked like
items.details: Jade carvings and gold beads are all original, small emerald beads and gold clasp added later
items.civilization: Nicoya civilization (Spanish explorers arrived 16th century, found culture with diverse cities, governments, agriculture, and arts)
items.symbolism: Jade held important symbolism to the Nicoya, believed to protect wearer and mediate between wearer and spiritual world

items.name: One-of-a-kind necklace by Michele della Valle
items.description: Renowned for color and lines, worn by celebrities, associated with Italian opera
items.note: Michele himself trained as operatic tenor
items.quote: 'The stones give birth to design, and not the other way around.' - Michele della Valle

items.name: Viking gold ring
items.description: Motif consists of dozens of circles stamped into eight serpentine forms
items.rarity: Rings such as this one are not common today
items.ownership: Gold rings were owned by Vikings with only the highest social status, hoarded by wealthy and buried in caches
items.note: Vikings were first people to sail to North America (not Spanish)
items.literary_connection: J.R.R. Tolkien's Lord of the Rings inspired by Viking myth of Andvari's ring
